title: Verify: Phaser render context unit tests
summary: Unit tests for createPhaserRenderContext with a fake Phaser scene
description: Test createSprite and the handle against a fake scene object, no real Phaser or canvas.
acceptance_criteria: Image created with spec values and resolved key
Interactive bounds, highlight, label and destroy behave as specified
technical_constraints: Mock 'phaser' with vi.mock; fake scene.add.image and scene.add.text return stub objects

steps.action: vi.mock('phaser') providing Geom.Rectangle (class storing args) and Geom.Rectangle.Contains. Build a fake scene whose add.image returns a chainable stub (setOrigin,setScale,setDepth,setInteractive,setVisible,setTint,clearTint,on,destroy as vi.fn) and add.text likewise. Call createPhaserRenderContext(scene, (id) => 'k:'+id).createSprite({key:'objects/x',x:5,y:6,scale:2,depth:3,label:'X',bounds:{x:0,y:0,width:10,height:20}}). Assert add.image called with (5,6,'k:objects/x'), setScale(2), setDepth(3), setInteractive called with a Rectangle of 0,0,10,20.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/phaserRenderContext.test.ts -t 'places image'

steps.action: Add tests: setHighlighted(true) calls setTint, false calls clearTint; setLabelVisible(true) calls label.setVisible(true); setVisible(false) hides label; onHover registers pointerover/pointerout and cb receives true/false when invoked; onClick registers pointerdown; destroy calls destroy on image and label.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/phaserRenderContext.test.ts
steps.expected: All tests in the file pass
